features.title: Spring Boot 3 application setup and health endpoint
features.behavior: A client sending GET /api/health receives HTTP 200 with status UP.

layers.label: layer_1_unit
layers.repair: Check pom.xml dependencies and verify Java 24 compilation.

layers.label: layer_2_integration
layers.repair: Ensure HealthController returns Map.of('status', 'UP') and tests pass.

layers.label: layer_3_architecture

evidence: make verify-feature FEATURE=FEAT-001 passed all 3 layers.
MockMvc verified HealthControllerTest: GET /api/health returned HTTP 200 with JSON status=UP.

features.title: Create and retrieve tasks via REST
features.behavior: A client can POST /api/tasks to create a task and GET /api/tasks/{id} to retrieve it.

layers.label: layer_1_unit
layers.repair: Check DTO and Entity field types.

layers.label: layer_2_integration
layers.repair: Verify TaskController delegates to TaskService and returns HTTP 201/200.

layers.label: layer_3_architecture
layers.repair: Do not let Controller access Repository directly.

verification: POST /api/tasks with title and description returns 201 Created.
GET /api/tasks/{id} returns the task with id, title, description, and status PENDING.
evidence: make verify-feature FEATURE=FEAT-002 passed all 3 layers.
POST /api/tasks verified with MockMvc returning 201 Created with JSON ID and status PENDING.
POST /api/tasks with blank title verified returning 400 Bad Request.
GET /api/tasks/{id} verified with MockMvc returning 200 OK and 404 for missing ID.

features.title: Update task lifecycle status
features.behavior: A client can PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/status to change status between PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED.

layers.label: layer_2_integration
layers.repair: Validate status transition rules in TaskService.

layers.label: layer_3_architecture
layers.repair: Ensure Service does not leak HTTP servlet exceptions.

verification: PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/status with status 'IN_PROGRESS' updates status and returns 200.
Attempting invalid transition returns 400 Bad Request.

features.title: Filter tasks by status
features.behavior: A client can GET /api/tasks?status=COMPLETED to retrieve only matching tasks.

layers.label: layer_2_integration
layers.repair: Ensure TaskService filters by status enum.

verification: GET /api/tasks?status=COMPLETED returns only tasks with status COMPLETED.
